Many QDP files are created manually, and expecting all commands to be in uppercase is unrealistic. Consequently, this issue can result in crashes or errors, preventing the proper reading and interpretation of QDP files in `astropy`.

The issue is well-specified and it is clear what is required for a successful solution.
